messages:
Maya R (Billing): Heads-up: Payment for INV-4782 failed during settlement. Gateway shows 'processing_error' then decline on second attempt.
Carlos P (Finance): Do we have decline_code or processor msg?
Jo (Support): Gateway payload: \n```
{\n  status: 'failed',\n  decline_code: 'bank_rejected',\n  processor_message: 'account_closed',\n  method: 'ACH'\n}
```
Customer attempted ACH. Micro-deposits didn't verify.
Tess (AE): Client is Mediva Labs. They said they closed the linked bank account last week and tried to add a new one via portal but hit an error.
Maya R (Billing): Portal error noted earlier today. billing-bot retried one more time automatically and failed. I'll block auto-retries for this account until we confirm new details.
billing-bot: auto_retry INV-4782 attempt=2 result=failed
Jo (Support): Created ticket SUP-8842 for portal payment form failure. Root cause likely frontend tokenization bug when account type = corporate
Tess (AE): I'll call the finance contact immediately. Ask them if they want to pay by wire to avoid ACH delays.
Carlos P (Finance): Wire is OK. Provide instructions and request remittance info. Also note: if they complete wire, we need to mark invoice as paid in ledger and reconcile bank statement.
Maya R (Billing): Wire details: Redwood Inference LLC / FirstCloud Bank / Routing: 110000111 / Account: 444422223333 / Ref: INV-4782. Please include company legal name and order ID.
Tess (AE): On call now. Customer requests same-day processing; can we expedite manual reconciliation if wire arrives today?
Maya R (Billing): Yes we can prioritize. Send proof of payment (SWIFT/ACH confirmation) to billing@redwood.ai and cc support. I'll chase reconciliation.
Jo (Support): Note for support ops: if customer retries ACH, ensure micro-deposit flow resets and inform them to wait 72h. Also step to surface friendly error in portal.
Tess (AE): Customer asked if we can temporarily lift service suspension while payment clears. What's policy?
Carlos P (Finance): For mid-market accounts we can permit a 48h grace at manager discretion. Maya, approve temporary lift?
Maya R (Billing): Approved 48h grace. I'll add a note to the account and set suspension timer to +48h from now.
billing-bot: account MedivaLabs grace_period set=48h by Maya R
Tess (AE): Sending wire instructions and asking for remittance proof. Will update thread after call.
Jo (Support): I'll attach SUP-8842 to the invoice and monitor portal bugfix rollout.
Maya R (Billing): After payment, tag INV-4782 with payment method and put into next batch reconciliation. Closing loop for now.
Carlos P (Finance): Thanks everyone. Keep me posted if wire comes in.
Tess (AE): Will do. :thumbsup:
